project_type: React Three Fiber + Three.js fighting game with deterministic 60 Hz combat sim
build_system: npm with Vite bundler and tsc compiler
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and bundling. Run npm run test to verify no regressions in combat/animation/rendering logic. Start dev server with npm run dev and visually confirm fighters grounded, contact shadows visible, water splashes on landing, road markings present, and lighting consistent.
environment_constraints: Deterministic 60 Hz combat sim in GameEngine.ts must not be touched except for VFX event emission. All changes are rendering/VFX only. STAGE_FLOOR_Y=0 is the ground plane. Fighter physics uses f.y where 0=floor contact.
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing combat mechanics, 15 fighters, abilities, multiplayer lockstep determinism. Fix implementation rather than rebuilding. Test changes do not break existing tests.
key_patterns: VFX events emitted via bus.emit from GameEngine trigger spawns in VFXLayer.tsx which calls vfxManager.ts methods. Fighter rendering: FighterView.tsx wraps ProceduralFighter (rig.ts) or ModelFighter (GlbFighter.tsx). Both set position from f.x, f.y, 0. Arena: CityStage.tsx renders ground plane at Y=0 with rotation[-PI/2,0,0]. Ground has receiveShadow=true. FighterLights.tsx key light has castShadow. Fighter meshes have castShadow/receiveShadow=true. Constants in src/config/constants.ts define LAND_IMPACT thresholds and STAGE_FLOOR_Y=0.
relevant_files: src/game/GameEngine.ts (lines 1095-1145: physics() landing detection and VFX emission)
src/vfx/vfxManager.ts (spawnDust, spawnBurst, spawnSparks methods — add spawnWaterSplash)
src/vfx/VFXLayer.tsx (event bus listener, calls vfx spawns)
src/arenas/CityStage.tsx (Ground component lines 250-290, directionalLight castShadow line ~350)
src/game/types.ts (GameEvent type union for vfx events)
directory_structure: src/game/ (GameEngine, types, eventBus), src/vfx/ (vfxManager, VFXLayer, powerProfiles), src/fighters/ (FighterView, GlbFighter, rig, characters), src/arenas/ (CityStage, TokyoStreet, textures, stages), src/config/ (constants), src/animations/ (animPlayer, animData, types)
